zh.title: 统一的深色工作台与更安全的账户入口
items: Android 手机端弃用原有浅色 Material 外观，统一采用 Web 工作台的深色配色、紧凑边框、消息气泡、导航和状态层级。
登录、配对、会话、审批、Agents、设备与版本记录页面共享同一套响应式视觉系统，并通过 320、360 和 390 像素窄屏测试。
手机端头像现在只打开账户菜单；版本记录和退出登录是菜单内独立操作，点击头像不会退出会话。
Web 工作台把客服、价格、服务条款和隐私政策移入侧边栏，不再占用主会话区域。
Web 头像点击只展开账户菜单，显式退出支持焦点管理、Escape、外部点击关闭和慢请求防重复。
新增树状 Markdown 回归用例，覆盖侧边栏信息、账户菜单、响应式、会话撤销和端到端加密清理边界。

en.title: A unified dark workbench and safer account entry
items: Android replaces the previous light Material appearance with the Web workbench's dark palette, compact borders, message surfaces, navigation, and status hierarchy.
Sign-in, pairing, conversations, approvals, Agents, Device, and release notes now share one responsive visual system validated at 320, 360, and 390 pixel widths.
The mobile avatar now opens the account menu only; release notes and sign-out are separate menu actions, so tapping the avatar never ends the session.
The Web workbench moves support, pricing, terms, and privacy links into the sidebar so they no longer consume the main conversation area.
The Web avatar now opens an account menu, with explicit sign-out, focus management, Escape and outside-click dismissal, and duplicate slow-request protection.
A tree-structured Markdown regression suite now covers sidebar information, account menus, responsive behavior, session revocation, and end-to-end encryption cleanup boundaries.
